<vbox flex="1" class="contentPane largeDialogContainer">
      <hbox align="center">
        <label data-l10n-id="filter-search-label" control="filter" />

          type="search"
          id="filter"
          aria-controls="cookiesList"
          oninput="gCookiesWindow.filter()"
        />
      </hbox>
